title: File Tracking Entity (with Dataset Metadata)
description: Azure Table Storage entity tracking discovery, processing status, and dataset metadata for each CSV file. PartitionKey = site_id (string), RowKey = SHA-256 hash of S3 key. Extended with ADLS storage and ingestion metadata fields (populated on completion).

RowKey.description: SHA-256 hash of the full S3 key, truncated to 64 characters

Size.description: File size in bytes from S3 listing

LastModified.description: ISO-8601 last-modified timestamp from S3 listing

EnqueuedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the work item was dispatched

CompletedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the worker finished processing

CorrelationId.description: Correlation ID of the dispatcher run that enqueued this file

StoragePath.description: ADLS Gen2 file path where the CSV was stored (set on completion)

FileHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file content (set on completion)

IngestionId.description: UUID identifying this ingestion run (set on completion)

SourceUrl.description: Original S3 download URL (set on completion)

IngestionTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the file was stored in ADLS (set on completion)
